metadata.title: Positivity of minimal volume entropy for some closed manifolds with zero simplicial volume
metadata.abstract: For every integer $m\ge4$, we construct a closed connected oriented smooth $m$-manifold whose simplicial volume is zero and whose minimal volume entropy is positive. This answers negatively the question, attributed to Gromov, whether vanishing simplicial volume implies vanishing minimal volume entropy. Each example has a connected regular five-sheeted covering with zero minimal volume entropy, so vanishing of this invariant does not descend through finite coverings.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 零单纯形体积与正极小体积熵的反例
analysis.workSummary: 对每个整数m≥4，作者构造闭连通定向光滑m维流形，使其单纯形体积为零而极小体积熵为正，否定归于Gromov的蕴含问题。每个反例都有一个连通正则五重覆盖，其极小体积熵为零。
techniques: 单纯形体积与极小体积熵
analysis.breakthrough: 给出m≥4全范围的反例，并表明极小体积熵的消失可以在有限覆盖上存在而无法下降到底空间。
analysis.limitations: 结论限于m≥4与文中所构造流形。摘要没有说明具体粘合构造和熵正性的判据。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
